title: Design System: Benz Chitchai showroom review

display.purpose: Project identity; Georgia is an intentional system-font substitute.

body.purpose: Root text and inherited Thai-capable fallback stack.

control.purpose: Buttons, select controls, text inputs, and textarea.

label.purpose: Visible labels in the review form.

small.purpose: Help, privacy, coordinates, and counter text.

motion.name: button-state
motion.purpose: Button transitions only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: receipt
motion.purpose: Confirmed receipt reveal only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

components.name: Primary submission button
components.description: Full-width primary action. The observed interface is disabled while its endpoint is empty; this specimen preserves that state.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-primary" disabled>ส่งความเห็น</button>
components.css: .ds-primary{font:600 .875rem/1.5 Arial,Thonburi,'Noto Sans Thai',sans-serif;background:var(--accent,#0078d6);color:var(--surface,#fff);border:1px solid var(--accent,#0078d6);border-radius:9999px;min-height:48px;padding:10px 14px;width:100%;cursor:pointer}.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:#0068ba;border-color:#0068ba}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #0078d6;outline-offset:3px}.ds-primary:disabled{background:#e3e3e3;color:#555;border-color:#c4c4c4;cursor:not-allowed}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-primary{transition:background-color .15s ease-out,border-color .15s ease-out}}

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Neutral pill control used for view and location actions.
components.css: .ds-secondary{font:600 .875rem/1.5 Arial,Thonburi,'Noto Sans Thai',sans-serif;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--text,#191919);border:1px solid var(--line,#b6b6b6);border-radius:9999px;min-height:44px;padding:10px 14px;cursor:pointer}.ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled){background:#eaeaea;border-color:#191919}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #0078d6;outline-offset:3px}.ds-secondary:disabled{background:#e3e3e3;color:#555;border-color:#c4c4c4;cursor:not-allowed}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.ds-secondary{transition:background-color .15s ease-out,border-color .15s ease-out}}

components.name: View navigation
components.description: A wrapping view selector with a dark aria-pressed selection. The preview is static; it does not operate the model.
components.html: <nav class="ds-views" aria-label="มุมมอง 3 มิติ"><button type="button" class="ds-view" aria-pressed="true">จากทางเข้า</button><button type="button" class="ds-view" aria-pressed="false">มุม smart</button><button type="button" class="ds-view" aria-pressed="false">มองจากด้านบน</button></nav>

components.name: Text input
components.description: Near-square optional author field with an explicit label and visible keyboard focus.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-name">ชื่อ</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-name" name="name" maxlength="80" autocomplete="name">
components.css: .ds-field-label{display:block;font:600 .875rem/1.55 Arial,Thonburi,'Noto Sans Thai',sans-serif;color:var(--text,#191919);margin:16px 0 6px}.ds-input{font:.875rem/1.5 Arial,Thonburi,'Noto Sans Thai',sans-serif;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--text,#191919);border:1px solid var(--line,#b6b6b6);border-radius:2px;min-height:44px;padding:10px 14px;width:100%;max-width:100%;caret-color:var(--accent,#0078d6)}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #0078d6;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Comment textarea
components.description: Required free text with a 3,000-character limit, vertical resizing, and muted placeholder. Counter updates belong to the application script.
components.html: หนึ่งประเด็นต่อหนึ่งความเห็น ช่วยให้ติดตามง่าย0 / 3,000
components.css: .ds-comment-label{display:block;font:600 .875rem/1.55 Arial,Thonburi,'Noto Sans Thai',sans-serif;color:var(--text,#191919);margin:16px 0 6px}.ds-required{font-weight:400;font-size:.75rem;color:var(--muted,#575757);margin-left:4px}.ds-textarea{font:.875rem/1.5 Arial,Thonburi,'Noto Sans Thai',sans-serif;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--text,#191919);border:1px solid var(--line,#b6b6b6);border-radius:2px;min-height:118px;padding:10px 14px;width:100%;max-width:100%;resize:vertical;caret-color:var(--accent,#0078d6)}.ds-textarea::placeholder{color:#626262;opacity:1}.ds-textarea:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #0078d6;outline-offset:3px}.ds-counter{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:4px;font:.75rem/1.55 Arial,Thonburi,'Noto Sans Thai',sans-serif;color:var(--muted,#575757);margin-top:5px}.ds-count{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}

narrative.overview:
This is a scoped extraction of the implemented v05 client review interface surrounding the unchanged v04 schematic model. Its visual language uses a black header, white and pale-gray surfaces, dark text, serif project heading, sans-serif controls, and blue action and location accents. No creative metaphor or additional user-confirmed aesthetic preferences are assigned.

The requested Mercedes-Benz alignment is limited to public-web reference: Mercedes-Benz Thailand. The Mercedes-Benz Brand Design System portal is gated; this document does not establish access to its private specifications, official brand compliance, or brand approval. Georgia and the system sans-serif stack are intentional substitutes; no proprietary fonts or Mercedes-Benz logo are included.
keyCharacteristics: Black header and flat, light work surfaces.
Serif project heading with Thai-capable sans-serif controls.
Pill buttons, near-square fields, and visible keyboard focus.
Blue action and annotation accents, with text explaining status.
dos: Do preserve the implemented black header, light surfaces, and blue action and annotation accent.
Do retain the substitute font stacks and visible keyboard-focus treatment.
Do keep location coordinates, model revision, and readable submission status with the review interaction.
Do describe the interface as a public-web-inspired project review tool with an unverified backend until connection and write tests pass.
donts: Don't label these extracted tokens as official Mercedes-Benz BDS specifications or brand approval.
Don't add proprietary fonts or a Mercedes-Benz logo to this extraction.
Don't treat an annotation or comment as an automatic change to the v04 model.
Don't represent a disabled submission or an unconfirmed response as a saved Google Sheets comment.
